iti75:2.1: tayome bhikkhave puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ
iti75:3.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo sabbesaññeva na dātā hoti samaṇabrāhmaṇa kapaṇaddhikavanibbakayācakānaṃ annaṃ pānaṃ vatthaṃ yānaṃ mālāgandhaṃ vilepanaṃ seyyāvasathaṃ padīpeyyaṃ
iti75:3.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo avuṭṭhikasamo hoti. 2
iti75:4.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo ekaccānaṃ dātā hoti ekaccānaṃ na dātā samaṇabrāhmaṇakapaṇaddhikavanibbakayācakānaṃ annaṃ pānaṃ vatthaṃ yānaṃ mālāgandhaṃ vilepanaṃ seyyāvasathaṃ padīpeyyaṃ
iti75:4.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo padesavassī hoti. 3
iti75:5.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo sabbesaṃ deti samaṇabrāhmaṇakapaṇaddhikavanibbakayācakānaṃ annaṃ pānaṃ vatthaṃ yānaṃ mālāgandhaṃ vilepanaṃ seyyāvasathaṃ padīpeyyaṃ
iti75:5.4: ime kho bhikkhave tayo puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasminti.
iti75:11.1: ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā iti me sutanti.
